g.text: The number model of VectorDB spaces and rho:lang:vector (decision 54)
INGRESS: the exact value of each number (num.rs)
a numeric Par: one expression, no connective
GInt, GBigInt, GBool
a dyadic number
GDouble, GFloat32: the exact value of the float
a dyadic number
NaN and the infinities: NonFiniteValue
the zero
enters as
GBigRat, GFixedPoint: the reduced rational
dyadic when
is a power of two
a fixed-point scale above 4,096: ValueOutOfRange
a vector: dyadic when every element is dyadic, else rational
a wrong length: DimensionMismatch
KERNELS: exact, with no rounding of a partial sum (exact.rs)
dot, the squared euclidean distance, manhattan
dyadic vectors: one integer sum at one common exponent
rational vectors: a sum of reduced rationals
hamming and jaccard on binary vectors only
DECISIONS: exact comparisons
cosine by squared forms, with the signs first
distances: the lower value is better
threshold and radius: exact bounds
equal scores: the lower canonical rank first (decision 41)
DELIVERY: one rounding of an exact value
: the nearest f64, ties to even
dot, manhattan, hamming and jaccard
cosine and euclidean:
an exact integer square root of a scaled numerator
the mantissa rounds by the square of the odd midpoint
ValueOutOfRange
yes
beyond the finite range of f64?
no
rho:lang:vector: the widest kind of the inputs (ops.rs)
add, scale, dot: the exact value in the widest kind
integers: GInt, or GBigInt when it does not fit
a rational or a fixed point: GBigRat
a float: GDouble,
of the exact value
norm, distance: GDouble, the correctly rounded root
Concept colors
a number of a record, a query or a call
an exact step of the numeric core
a rounding to a delivered value
a failure
